about_the_game:
A cute yet slightly dark BGM music collection!
This pack includes 10 tracks, primarily featuring orchestral and synth compositions.
With tracks inspired by settings like deserts and snowfields, these tunes are easy to visualize in various scenes.
All tracks are loopable for seamless integration.

Music：F.Takumi(@TAKUMI_F64)

Illustration：Purinncream (@Cmf2I)

*******************************************

Audio: 10 tracks

● Track Descriptions

  • CADMP01 (Title): A perfect orchestral track for title screens.

  • CADMP02 (Stage 01): A slightly dark yet playful and pop-inspired track.

  • CADMP03 (Stage 02): A track inspired by a desert setting.

  • CADMP04 (Stage 03): A rhythmic and comical track.

  • CADMP05 (Stage Select): A calm, slightly melancholic track.

  • CADMP06 (Stage 04): A dungeon-inspired track.

  • CADMP07 (Stage 05): A track inspired by snowy landscapes.

  • CADMP08 (Stage 06): A dungeon-inspired track.

  • CADMP09 (Stage 07): A dramatic orchestral track, perfect for boss battles.

  • CADMP10 (Ending): An orchestral piece ideal for endings.

*******************************************

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
